configurations.name: moony-demo
runtimeArgs: HOME="$PWD/demo-home" RUSTUP_HOME="${RUSTUP_HOME:-$HOME/.rustup}" CARGO_HOME="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}" npm run tauri dev -- --config '{"app":{"windows":[{"title":"Moony","width":1400,"height":850,"minWidth":1024,"minHeight":700,"backgroundThrottling":"disabled"}]}}'

configurations.name: moony-firstrun
runtimeArgs: mkdir -p firstrun-home && HOME="$PWD/firstrun-home" RUSTUP_HOME="${RUSTUP_HOME:-$HOME/.rustup}" CARGO_HOME="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}" npm run tauri dev -- --config '{"app":{"windows":[{"title":"Moony","width":1400,"height":850,"minWidth":1024,"minHeight":700,"backgroundThrottling":"disabled"}]}}'

configurations.name: moony-demo-alt
runtimeArgs: mkdir -p demo-home && HOME="$PWD/demo-home" RUSTUP_HOME="${RUSTUP_HOME:-$HOME/.rustup}" CARGO_HOME="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}" npm run tauri dev -- --config '{"build":{"devUrl":"http://localhost:1421","beforeDevCommand":"npm run dev -- --port 1421 --strictPort"}}'
